required_evidence.proof: One isolated unpacked-byte field changes for the named control while unrelated bytes remain stable.
Minimum, midpoint, and maximum captures establish the raw representation and direction.
The same control and value on tracks 1 through 4 establish a constant per-track displacement.
The original frame and every changed frame pass checksum, length, decode, mutate, encode, and exact re-decode validation.
The edited scratch kit is loaded on the Analog Four, the intended control is observed or heard, and a returned kit capture confirms the value.

promotion_rule: All five required_evidence keys must be satisfied for each promoted semantic field; partial evidence remains blocked and produces zero events.
